items.title: Parker Hannifin (PH) Completes Filtration Group Acquisition
items.summary: Parker-Hannifin (NYSE:PH) has completed its acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation, expanding its global industrial filtration presence. The deal adds new filtration technologies and a wider aftermarket footprint across multiple regions. Management expects the combination to support earnings growth, new sales opportunities and cost synergies over time.
